qualityGate.title: Photo quality check
qualityGate.passed: The photo is good enough for analysis

hint.blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady, wait for focus and move closer to the leaf.
hint.tooDark: Too dark. Shoot in daylight or turn so that light falls on the plant.
hint.tooBright: Too bright. Step out of direct sun or shade the leaf.
hint.clippedHighlights: Parts of the frame are blown out. Avoid glare and direct sun on the leaf.
hint.clippedShadows: Shadows are too deep. Change the angle so the leaf is lit.
hint.noPlant: No plant is visible. Point the camera at the affected leaf, ear or pest.
hint.tooFar: The plant is too small in the frame. Move closer so the damage fills more of the photo.
